details: Vulnerability in the Oracle Order Management product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Transaction Entry).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Order Management.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Order Management accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).
